Construct aggregated divides from Stage-1 rec_div via rec_id_list

Source: R/aggregate_network_and_divides.R
construct_agg_divides.Rd

Given the network table from aggregate_network() (which carries flowpath_id -> rec_id_list) and the Stage-1 rec_div polygons, unions the rec_div members for each aggregated flowpath.

No raster, no snapping, no mapshaper. Stage-3 fill_small_holes and clean_gpkg_layer handle any residual topology.

Usage

construct_agg_divides(network, rec_div, flowpaths)

Arguments

network

Network data.frame from aggregate_network() with flowpath_id and rec_id_list.

rec_div

Stage-1 reconciled divide sf with flowpath_id (= rec_id).

flowpaths

Aggregated flowpath sf from aggregate_network().

Value

sf with divide_id, flowpath_toid, areasqkm, has_flowline, ds_id, type, geometry (POLYGON).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
agg     <- aggregate_network(flowpath = s1_fp, divide = rec_div, pois = pois)
rec_div <- sf::st_read("rec_div.gpkg", "divides")
divides <- construct_agg_divides(network   = agg$network,
                                 rec_div   = rec_div,
                                 flowpaths = agg$flowpaths)
} # }
